Name: Drawberry's Seasonal Cute Characters for the Bear Fam
Author: drawberry138
Description:
[b][u]I do NOT consent to my work being used to train AI or used in AI generation.[/u][/b]

[b][u]This mod is compatible with all other SCA/SCC mods. [/u][/b]

Oh hi! 

After many weeks, it’s done!!
If you’re a Seasonal Cuter Aesthetic lover like me and have also been missing Poltergeister’s brilliant work, here’s a my take on a matching mod for the Bear Fam! 

This mod [b]REQUIRES the[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16197][b]Bear Fam[/b][/url] and its requirements, [b]Content Patcher[/b], and[b] SMAPI[/b]. 
I [b]RECOMMEND[/b] you download Poltergeister's [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Vanilla SCC[/url] [/b]and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]East Scarp SCC[/url][/b]﻿, and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43012]my ESR SCC[/url][/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44756]C[b]ute ES festival outfits[/b][/url] mods for a unified look! ﻿ 

[b]Installation:[/b]
[list]
[*]download the mod[/*]
[*]drag it into your mods folder and unzip![/*]
[/list][b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]configurable noses[/*]
[*]configurable blue and black hair for Sig[/*]
[*]configurable freckles for Gunnar[/*]
[*]2 cute outfits per season[/*]
[*]cute outfits for festivals, other events, and the beach![/*]
[/list]If you like playing with this mod please consider endorsing it - I’m disabled and bedridden, so any support that can get my work out there helps!

 If you'd like, you can buy me a coffee [b][url=https://ko-fi.com/drawberry138]here[/url][/b]! I'd really appreciate it :) 

I really hope you enjoy my work! Much love and take care, Drawberry xo



 Special thanks to:
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/maddogofblank]Maddog[/url][/b] for creating such a wonderful mod, for her art, and for her permission for me to share this work[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister][b]Poltergeister[/b][/url] ﻿for her permissions and SCA work[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye]Abagaianye[/url][/b] for teaching me so well that I didn’t need to bother them this time around (who would’ve thought?!)[/*]
[*][b]My brother[/b] for the pattern on Teren’s blue army jacket in his portrait (pixel art is an untapped talent of yours wink wink nudge nudge please-team-up-with-me-more-thanks-ily) and for listening to me rant about walls of yellow error text and Teren’s hair in my portraits[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TenebrousNova]TenebrousNova[/url][/b] for your encouraging words and for Soot’s appearance in my take on Teren’s portraits[/*]
[*]The ES discord for being so welcoming, supportive, and encouraging![/*]
[/list]
